description: 北九州市 おでかけ交通・小倉南区東谷地区GTFSデータ [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 北九州市. おでかけ交通・小倉南区東谷地区のGTFS形式データです。 ※おでかけ交通事業は、バス路線廃止地区やバス路線のない高台地区、高齢化率が市の平均を上回る地区などにおいて、地域住民の交通手段を確保するため、採算性の確保を前提として、地域住民、交通事業者、市がそれぞれの役割分担のもとで連携して、マイクロバスやジャンボタクシー等を運行するものです。. Coverage: 北九州市. The portal files it under the publisher 北九州市. Its tags are 公共交通, 時刻表, 運賃. It offers 1 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2026-05-22 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
